turns.query: Quantify Beijing's summer-afternoon weekend-minus-weekday ozone contrasts in 2020-2022 and 2023-2025. Has the weekend effect persisted? What can this comparison say about the chemical regime?

What does pooling 2020-2025 conceal? For 2023-2025, quantify the corresponding odd-oxygen contrast and its paired sample size, alongside the NO2 result. Can these observations distinguish titration from a change in photochemical production?
